raw_segments.text: Which thus to Eve his welcome words renewed Eve easily my faith admit that all the good which we enjoy from heaven descends
But that from us ought should ascend to heaven so prevalent as to concern the mind of God high blessed or to incline his will
Hard to belief may seem yet this will prayer or one short sigh of human breath up born even to the seat of God
For since I sought by prayer the offended deity to appease
